fieldissues.issue: “Claims 2024 Election Had Fraud” says Trump alleged fraud, while the descriptions say his remarks cast doubt on counting and computers but did not explicitly claim the result was manipulated.
Pennsylvania election officials are tagged but are not identified in the descriptions.

proposedchanges.change: Use “Trump casts doubt on 2024 vote counting after election certification,” which matches the described remarks.
Remove Pennsylvania election officials unless the descriptions identify a specific official or action; retain U.S. Congress.

evidencebasis: The packet says Trump said some areas were still counting votes and praised Musk’s knowledge of Pennsylvania vote-counting computers.
The merged medium and long explicitly say he did not claim that the computers changed the result.
notes: The title and descriptions should describe the remarks without converting them into a direct fraud allegation.
